retrieval: Exact Fry PDF and 93-page IHES original preprint cached and hashed. Browser HTML and PDF requests failed for some endpoints; direct authorized PDF downloads succeeded. Publisher page failed. INSPIRE API supplied metadata but no full-text link; archive search then found the original. PMC Seiler-Simon page returned a challenge and no proof from it was used.
established_methods: Vector current contact, unitary holonomy transfer, Schatten Holder, two-dimensional determinant domination and Gaussian reweighting. No novelty claim for these methods.
development_notes: The initial static/time-dependent/Gaussian suite passed. The extended global-det3 and covariance computations passed their numerical assertions, then receipt serialization failed because a NumPy boolean was not JSON serializable. Converting that flag to a native bool fixed serialization; the full frozen suite was rerun.

Static uncorrected thermal traces violate the intended upper bound; retaining the independently fixed positive current contact restores agreement with the holonomy formula. This is a tested subtraction requirement, not a new tunable counterterm.
Finite spacetime det3 cutoffs converge to the holonomy-plus-quadratic identity with a maximum final error below 9e-6; finite-cutoff numbers are not asserted exact.

A final gauge-consistency check uses a time-dependent pure gauge that vanishes at the spatial endpoints and has trivial temporal holonomy. Four spatial cutoffs converge toward Delta=1; the final absolute log error is below 2e-6.
physical_limits: Gaussian inner action and specified antiperiodic reference only. Actual constrained covariance, compact/infrared sectors, nonlinear gauge action, gauged exterior, photon continuum limit, Lorentzian reconstruction, local renormalized stress and smooth physical matching remain unproved.
contribution_decision: Continue physical long-return damping as primary and matched finite-duration transfer as fallback. In the defined antiperiodic unequal-return free Dirac model, the covariantly normalized vector determinant obeys 0<=Delta<=1 at all amplitudes. Static unitary holonomy and thermal trace Holder bounds yield a positive regulated gauge marginal, with controlled large-field tails and total variation under explicit Gaussian noise bounds. The fixed flat annulus reference gives O(log^3 q/q) total-variation control on duration O(log^2 q). The physical gauge constraints, nonlinear action, exterior, photon-cutoff removal, local stress and Lorentzian state remain open. Diamagnetic determinant bounds are established prior work; no consequential physical novelty or endpoint is accepted.
next_decisive_question: Derive the physical constrained electric/rotational gauge action and covariance, including infrared/global sectors, nonlinear gauge vertices and the full source-dependent exterior; then establish the coupled quantum state, local renormalized stress and smooth matching. The specified inner Gaussian gauge marginal now has full determinant and weighted-tail control.
